title: PresentationColorTheme
description: Presentation color theme defining the background, text, semantic accent colors, and chart palette. All colors use a reusable RGB color type with three integer channels from 0 to 255 and a human-readable color name.

text.description: Primary presentation text color used for titles, headings, and high-emphasis content.

accentGrey.description: Neutral treatment for secondary information, structural elements, borders, dividers, disabled states, metadata, and other low-emphasis content.

accentRed.description: Semantic treatment for failures, risks, incidents, warnings, and urgent information.

accentGreen.description: Semantic treatment for positive outcomes, recommendations, completed work, and healthy states.

accentBlue.description: Semantic treatment for informational content, neutral emphasis, and reference data.

accentAmber.description: Semantic treatment for caution, emerging risks, trends, and attention-worthy information.

accentTeal.description: Semantic treatment for secondary emphasis, technical content, systems, data flows, and supporting information.

accentYellow.description: Semantic treatment for attention, highlights, pending states, notable changes, and information requiring visual emphasis.

accentPurple.description: Semantic treatment for specialized, exploratory, analytical, or distinctive content that benefits from visual differentiation.

mutedText.description: Secondary text color for supporting descriptions, metadata, labels, and lower-emphasis content.

chartColors.description: Ordered palette of colors used for categorical charts and visual data series.

presentationAccent.description: Semantic presentation accent consisting of a primary accent color, a supporting background color, and a text color intended to remain legible when rendered over the accent background.

accent.description: Primary accent color used for borders, outlines, indicators, icons, or other visual emphasis.

background.description: Background or fill color used with the accent treatment.

text.description: Text color intended to be rendered on top of the accent background.

presentationColor.description: A presentation color represented by RGB channel values, an optional opacity, and a human-readable color name. RGB values are authoritative; the name is a descriptive label. Opacity defaults to fully opaque when omitted.

name.description: Human-readable descriptive name for the color.

opacity.description: Optional opacity from 0 to 1, where 0 is fully transparent and 1 is fully opaque.
